message.content:
Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a distinct anomaly where the values drop significantly from the normal range (around -5 to 0 mm) to a much lower range (around -10 to -15 mm). This shift occurs abruptly near the end of the series.

Looking at the x-axis ("Original daily index"):
- The sharp drop happens just before index 670.
- The low values persist until the end of the plotted data, which is around index 730.

Therefore, the anomalous range is approximately [670, 730].

[[670, 730]]
